rationale.en: The Analyst says the measure requires the state to provide a voter identification card at no cost to voters who request one, usable as the government-issued identification for verification. The Analyst also says Proposition 39 requires the Legislature to pass additional laws and would need to clarify details not defined in the proposition, "like which forms of identification could be used", so the variety of IDs the argument describes is not established in the guide. "Easily-obtained" is a characterization the guide does not address.
